title: Air France Gets Bumped From Denver, Spirit Sells Its Last Plane, and a Senator Discovers Furries
summary: United's new Denver-Paris route just pushed Air France out of the market entirely — a perfect case study in what happens when a hub carrier flexes. Plus, Spirit Airlines sells off its very last aircraft for $668 million, Airbus finds a corrosion defect in hundreds of A321neos, Dubai and Iran trade airspace bans, and a U.S. senator delivers the most bizarre aviation safety warning we've heard all year.
